notes:
v4.6.38 — Per-bot sub-portfolios on IBKR + bulletproof bot startup

🆕 NEW — IBKR per-bot sub-portfolio isolation
• IBKR is a single shared account, so each bot now gets its own software-partitioned sub-portfolio (cash + holdings) it ALONE can touch — bots can no longer spend each other's cash or sell each other's shares.
• Tools → IBKR: each bot has a Client ID + allocation %. Saving seeds a sub-portfolio (allocation % of available account cash) for any bot that doesn't have one yet.
• Add a bot → it starts with allocated cash only. Remove a bot → its entire sub-portfolio is MARKET-SOLD and the cash is freed for manual redistribution (on any failure the bot is kept, never orphaned).
• Custom bots run from a SEPARATE file on IBKR (bots/<broker>/<name>.py) so their decisions diverge from the Alpaca copy — different sub-portfolio, separately editable.

🆕 NEW — SHORT bot now runs on IBKR
• SHORT is wired through the broker abstraction (ledger-backed SELL-to-open / BUY-to-cover). LONG, SHORT and every custom (Make Bot) bot now place trades on IBKR.
• DAY stays Alpaca-only for now: it uses bracket orders (stop-loss + take-profit legs) which IBKR market-order execution can't yet honour — running it on IBKR would drop its protective legs.

🛡️ HARDENED — bots can't die on startup anymore
• The bot framework now retries broker/key initialization inside its loop instead of crashing — if keys or the gateway aren't ready, the bot waits and retries (no restart needed).
• Alpaca key resolution never throws a raw KeyError; missing keys surface as a clear, actionable message.
• crypto bot rebuilt on the framework so it runs identically (and safely) on both Alpaca and IBKR.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
